G0301.forms: Ἀμώς, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹץ, [[r:ISA.1.1|Isa 1:1]]; עָמוֹס, [[r:AMO.1.1|Amo 1:1]]; אָמוֹן, [[r:2KI.21.18|4Ki.21:18]] ff. B)
senses: as in 2Ki, Lc. B (Α. Ἀμμών; Jos., Ἀμμών, "Αμωσσς), Amon: [[r:MAT.1.10|Mat 1:10.]]

G0395.strongs: a rising of light, i.e. dawn (figuratively); by implication, the east (also in plural)
senses: the sun-rising, the east (MM, VGT, see word): [[r:MAT.2.2|Mat 2:2]], 9, [[r:REV.21.13|Rev 21:13]]; ἀ. ἡλίου, [[r:REV.7.2|Rev 7:2 16:12]] (WΗ, p1.); pl., [[r:MAT.2.1|Mat 2:1 8:11 24:27]], [[r:LUK.13.29|Luk 13:29]].† (AS)
trans., to bend or turn back.
Intrans., to return: [[r:MAT.2.12|Mat 2:12]], [[r:ACT.18.21|Act 18:21]], [[r:HEB.11.15|Heb 11:15]]; metaphorically (cf. MM, VGT, see word), [[r:LUK.10.6|Luk 10:6.]]† (AS)

G0302.root: a primary particle, denoting a supposition, wish, possibility or uncertainty
senses: conditional particle, which cannot usually be separately translated in English, its force depending on the constructions which contain it (see further, LS, see word; WM, §xlii; M, Pr., 165 ff.; MM, VGT, see word).

with indic, imperfect or aor., expressing what would be or would have been if (εἰ with impf., aor. or plpf.) some condition were or had been fulfilled: [[r:LUK.7.39|Luk 7:39 17:6]], [[r:JHN.5.46|Jhn 5:46]], [[r:GAL.1.10|Gal 1:10]], [[r:MAT.12.7|Mat 12:7 24:43]], [[r:1CO.2.8|1Co 2:8]], [[r:ACT.18.14|Act 18:14]], [[r:1JN.2.19|1Jn 2:19]], al. The protasis is sometimes understood (as also in cl.): [[r:MAT.25.27|Mat 25:27]], [[r:LUK.19.23|Luk 19:23]]. In hypothetical sentences, expressing unreality, ἄν (as often in late writers, more rarely in cl.) is omitted: [[r:JHN.8.39|Jhn 8:39 15:24 19:11]], [[r:ROM.7.7|Rom 7:7]], [[r:GAL.4.15|Gal 4:15]];
with opt., inf., ptcp. (cl.; see LS, see word; M, Int., §275; M, Pr., 167:4).
In combination with conditional, relative, temporal, and final words;
in protasis with εἰ, in Attic contr. ἐάν, which see;

in conditional, relative, and temporal clauses (coalescing with ὅτε, ἐπεί, etc.; see: ὅταν, ἐπάν, etc.), ever, soever; (α) with pres., ἡνίκα, [[r:2CO.3.15|2Co 3:15]]; ὃς ἄν, [[r:ROM.9.15|Rom 9:15]] (LXX) 16:2, al.; ὅσοι ἄν, [[r:LUK.9.5|Luk 9:5]]; ὡς ἄν, [[r:ROM.15.24|Rom 15:24]] (M, Pr., 167); (β) with aor., ὃς ἄν, [[r:MAT.5.21|Mat 5:21, 22, 31]]; ἕως ἄν, until, [[r:MAT.2.13|Mat 2:13]], [[r:MRK.6.10|Mrk 6:10]], al.; ὡς ἄν, as soon as (M, Pr., 167), [[r:1CO.11.34|1Co 11:34]], [[r:PHP.2.23|Php 2:23]]. On the frequently use of ἐάν for ἄν with the foregoing words, see: ἐάν;

in late Gk., when some actual fact is spoken of, with indic.: ὅταν (which see); ὅπου ἄν, [[r:MRK.6.56|Mrk 6:56]] (M, Pr., 168); καθότι ἄν, [[r:ACT.2.45|Act 2:45 4:35]]; ὡς ἄν, [[r:1CO.12.2|1Co 12:2.]]
in iterative construction, with imperfect and aor. indic. (M, Pr., 167): [[r:ACT.2.45|Act 2:45 4:35]], [[r:1CO.12.2|1Co 12:2]].
with optative, giving a potential sense to a question or wish: [[r:ACT.8.31|Act 8:31 26:29]].
Elliptical constructions: εἰ μή τι ἄν (M, Pr., 169), [[r:1CO.7.5|1Co 7:5]]; ὡς ἄν, with inf., as it were (op. cit. 167), [[r:2CO.10.9|2Co 10:9.]] (AS)

G0337.strongs: to take up, i.e. adopt; by implication, to take away (violently), i.e. abolish, murder
G0337.kjv: put to death, kill, slay, take away, take up
senses: to take away, make an end of, destroy (for late exx. of various senses, see MM, VGT, see word);
of things (as frequently in cl. of laws, etc.): [[r:HEB.10.9|Heb 10:9]];

G0305.kjv: arise, ascend (up), climb (go, grow, rise, spring) up, come (up)
senses: of persons: ἐπί συκομωρέαν, [[r:LUK.19.4|Luk 19:4]]; εἰς τ. πλοῖον, [[r:MRK.6.51|Mrk 6:51]]; εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, [[r:MAT.20.17|Mat 20:17]]; εἰς τ. ἱερόν, with inf. (M, Pr., 205), [[r:LUK.18.10|Luk 18:10]]; with mention of place of departure, [[r:MAT.3.16|Mat 3:16]] (ἀπό), [[r:ACT.8.39|Act 8:39]] (ἐκ);

of things, to rise, spring up, come up: a fish, [[r:MAT.17.27|Mat 17:27]]; smoke, [[r:REV.8.4|Rev 8:4]]; plants growing, [[r:MAT.13.7|Mat 13:7]]; metaphorically, of things coming up in one's mind (as Heb. לֵב אֵל עָלָה; 4Ki.12:4al.), [[r:LUK.24.38|Luk 24:38]], [[r:1CO.2.9|1Co 2:9]]; of prayers, [[r:ACT.10.4|Act 10:4]]; messages, [[r:ACT.21.31|Act 21:31]] (for late exx., see MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

G0321.strongs: to lead up; by extension to bring out; specially, to sail away
G0321.kjv: bring (again, forth, up again), depart, launch (forth), lead (up), loose, offer, sail, set forth, take up
senses: ἀν-άγω to lead or bring up: before είς, with accusative loc., [[r:MAT.4.1|Mat 4:1]], [[r:LUK.2.22|Luk 2:22 4:5]] (WH om. είς, κ.τ.λ.), [[r:ACT.9.39|Act 9:39 16:34]]; of raising the dead (cl.), ἐκ νεκρῶν, [[r:ROM.10.7|Rom 10:7]], [[r:HEB.13.20|Heb 13:20]]; to produce and set before, τ. λαῷ, [[r:ACT.12.4|Act 12:4]] (MM, VGT, see word); in sacrificial sense (MM, 1 with), to offer, θυσίαν, [[r:ACT.7.41|Act 7:41.]] Mid., in nautical sense (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.), to put to sea: [[r:LUK.8.22|Luk 8:22]], [[r:ACT.13.13|Act 13:13 16:11 18:21 20:3, 13 21:1-2 27:2, 4 27:12, 21 28:10-11]] (cf.ἐπ-ανάγω).† (AS)

G0393.kjv: (a-, make to) rise, at the rising of, spring (up), be up
senses: Intrans., to rise: φῶς, [[r:MAT.4.16|Mat 4:16]] (= [[r:ISA.9.1|Isa 9:1]]); ὁ ἥλιος, [[r:MAT.13.6|Mat 13:6]], [[r:MRK.4.6|Mrk 4:6 16:2]], [[r:JAS.1.11|Jas 1:11]]; νεφέλη, [[r:LUK.12.54|Luk 12:54]]; φωσφόρος, [[r:2PE.1.19|2Pe 1:19]]; ὁ Κύριος, prob. with ref. to metaphorically of sun or star, [[r:HEB.7.14|Heb 7:14]] (cf. ἐξ-ανατέλλω).† (AS)

to make to recline: [[r:MRK.6.39|Mrk 6:39]], WH, mg., [[r:LUK.12.37|Luk 12:37.]] Pass., to lie back, recline: [[r:MAT.8.11|Mat 8:11 14:19]], [[r:LUK.13.29|Luk 13:29]].† SYN.: ἀνάκειμαι (which see), ἀναπίπτω (AS)

G0345.strongs: to recline (as a corpse or at a meal)
G0345.kjv: guest, lean, lie, sit (down, at meat), at the table
senses: in cl., as pass. of ἀνατίθημ, to be laid up, laid: [[r:MRK.5.40|Mrk 5:40]] Rec.

In late writers (cf. MM, VGT, see word) = κεῖσθαι, κατακεῖσθαι, to recline at table: [[r:MAT.26.20|Mat 26:20]]; part. ἀνακείμενος, [[r:MAT.9.10|Mat 9:10 22:10-11 26:7]], [[r:MRK.6.26|Mrk 6:26 14:18 16:14]], [[r:LUK.22.27|Luk 22:27]], [[r:JHN.6.11|Jhn 6:11 12:2 13:23, 28]].† SYN.: ἀνακλίνω, ἀναπίπτω, the latter denoting an act rather than a state and thus in [[r:JHN.13.25|Jhn 13:25]] differing from ἀνάκειμαι (see. [[r:JHN.13.23|Jhn 13:23]]) by indicating a change of position. (AS)

G0308.strongs: to look up; by implication, to recover sight
senses: to look up: [[r:MRK.8.24|Mrk 8:24]], al.; before εἰς, [[r:MAT.14.19|Mat 14:19]], al. (Xen., Plat.).
to recover sight (Plat., Aristoph.; cf. MM, VGT, see word): [[r:MAT.11.5|Mat 11:5]], [[r:JHN.9.11|Jhn 9:11]], al (AS)

G0373.strongs: (reflexively) to repose (literally or figuratively (be exempt), remain); by implication, to refresh
senses: ἀνα-παύω, to give intermission from labour, to give rest, refresh: [[r:MAT.11.28|Mat 11:28]], [[r:1CO.16.18|1Co 16:18]], Phm 20; pass., Phm 7, [[r:2CO.7.13|2Co 7:13]]. Mid., to take rest, enjoy rest: [[r:MAT.26.45|Mat 26:45]], [[r:MRK.6.31|Mrk 6:31 14:41]], [[r:LUK.12.19|Luk 12:19]], [[r:REV.6.11|Rev 6:11 14:13]]; as in Heb. ofIs 11:2 (עַל נוּחַ), τὸ πνεῦμα ἐφ᾽ ὑᾶμς ἀ., [[r:1PE.4.14|1Pe 4:14.]] (In π. this word is used as a technical agricultural term; see MM, VGT, see word; and cf. Le 2634 f.; Cremer, 826.)† (AS)

ἀνά-παυσις, -εως, ή (ἀνάπαύω) cessation, rest, refreshment: [[r:MAT.11.26|Mat 11:26 12:43]], [[r:LUK.11.24|Luk 11:24]], [[r:REV.4.8|Rev 4:8 14:11]].† SYN.: ἄνεσις (lit, the relaxation of the strings of a lyre), prop. signifies the rest or ease which comes from the relaxation of unfavour­able conditions, as, e.g. affliction: ἀνάπ., the rest which comes from the temporary cessation of labour (see Tr., Stn., § xl; Cremer, 827; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

G0314.strongs: to know again, i.e. (by extension) to read
senses: to know certainly, know again, recognize.

Of written characters, to read: [[r:MAT.24.15|Mat 24:15]], [[r:MRK.13.14|Mrk 13:14]], [[r:ACT.15.31|Act 15:31 23:34]], [[r:EPH.3.4|Eph 3:4]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.22.31|Mat 22:31]], [[r:MRK.12.10|Mrk 12:10]] [[r:LUK.6.3|Luk 6:3]], [[r:JHN.19.20|Jhn 19:20]], [[r:ACT.8.30|Act 8:30, 32]], [[r:2CO.1.13|2Co 1:13]], [[r:REV.1.3|Rev 1:3]]; with accusative of person(s), Ἠσαίαν τ. προφήτην, [[r:ACT.8.28|Act 8:28, 30]]; before ἐν, [[r:MAT.12.5|Mat 12:5 21:42]], [[r:MRK.12.26|Mrk 12:26]] (so. ἐν τ. νόμῳ), [[r:LUK.10.26|Luk 10:26]]; before ὅτι, [[r:MAT.19.4|Mat 19:4 21:16]]; τί ἐποίησε, [[r:MAT.12.3|Mat 12:3]], [[r:MRK.2.25|Mrk 2:25]]; pass. [[r:2CO.3.2|2Co 3:2]]; of reading aloud (MM, VGT, see word), [[r:LUK.4.16|Luk 4:16]], [[r:ACT.13.27|Act 13:27 15:21]], [[r:2CO.3.15|2Co 3:15]], [[r:COL.4.16|Col 4:16]], [[r:1TH.5.27|1Th 5:27]] (M, Th., in l).† (AS)

G0338.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and [[w:G0159]] (in the sense of [[w:G0156]])

G0378.strongs: to complete; by implication, to occupy, supply; figuratively, to accomplish (by coincidence ot obedience)
senses: to fill up, make full (in π. of com­pleting contracts and making up rent; cf. MM, VGT, see word): τόπον, take one's place (cf. Heb. מָקוֹם שָׁלַם), [[r:1CO.14.16|1Co 14:16]]; άμαρτίας, complete the number, [[r:1TH.2.16|1Th 2:16]]; τ. νόμον, observe perfectly, [[r:GAL.6.2|Gal 6:2]]; pass., προφητεία, fulfilled, [[r:MAT.13.14|Mat 13:14.]]

G0303.strongs: properly, up; but (by extension) used (distributively) severally, or (locally) at (etc.)
G0303.kjv: and, apiece, by, each, every (man), in, through
senses: ἀνά prep. (the rarest in NT; M, Pr., 98; MM, VGT, see word), prop., upwards, up, always with accusative

In phrases: ἀ. μέσον, among, between, with genitive, [[r:MAT.13.1|Mat 13:1-58 25:1-46]], [[r:MRK.7.31|Mrk 7:31]], [[r:1CO.6.5|1Co 6:5]] (M, Pr., 99), [[r:REV.7.17|Rev 7:17]]; ἀ. μέρος, in turn, [[r:1CO.14.27|1Co 14:27]] (both found in Polyb.; cf. MGr. ἀνάμεσα).
Adverbially ("a vulgarism," B1., § 51, 5; cf. Deiss., BS, 139 f.), ἀ. εἷς ἕκαστος, [[r:REV.21.21|Rev 21:21.]] As prefix, ἀ. signifies

G0307.root: from [[w:G0303]] and a derivative of the base of [[w:G0939]]
G0307.strongs: to cause to go up, i.e. haul (a net)
senses: ἀνα-βιβάζω (causal of ἀναβαίνω), to make go up, draw up, as a ship (Xen.): σαγήνην, [[r:MAT.13.48|Mat 13:48]] (metaphorically, MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

(ἀνάγκη), to necessitate, compel by force or persuasion, constrain: with accusative, [[r:2CO.12.11|2Co 12:11]]; id. with inf., [[r:MAT.14.22|Mat 14:22]], [[r:MRK.6.45|Mrk 6:45]], [[r:LUK.14.23|Luk 14:23]], [[r:ACT.26.11|Act 26:11]] (on the imperfect here, see Field, Notes, 141; M, Pr., 128 f., 247), [[r:GAL.2.14|Gal 2:14 6:12]]; pass., C. inf., [[r:ACT.28.19|Act 28:19]], [[r:GAL.2.3|Gal 2:3]] (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0377.strongs: to fall back, i.e. lie down, lean back
senses: In late writers = ἀνα-κλίνομαι, to recline for a repast (MM, VGT, see word): at table, [[r:LUK.11.37|Luk 11:37 14:10 17:7 22:14]], [[r:JHN.13.12|Jhn 13:12 21:20]]; on the ground, [[r:MAT.15.35|Mat 15:35]] [[r:MRK.6.40|Mrk 6:40 8:6]] [[r:JHN.6.10|Jhn 6:10]]; to lean back, [[r:JHN.13.25|Jhn 13:25]] (T, ἐπιπεσών; see: ἀνάκειμαι, ad fin.).† SYN.: ἀνάκειμαι (which see), ἀνακλίνομαι (AS)

to carry or lead up: with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.17.1|Mat 17:1]], [[r:MRK.9.2|Mrk 9:2]]; pass., [[r:LUK.24.51|Luk 24:51]] (WH, rejects, R, mg. omits); ἀ. τ. ἁμαρτίας ἐπί τ. ξύλον (see Deiss., 135, 88 f.; ICC, in l; MM, VGT, see word): [[r:1PE.2.24|1Pe 2:24.]]

In LXX and NT, to bring to the altar, to offer (see Hort on 1Pe, l.with): θυσίας, etc., [[r:HEB.7.27|Heb 7:27 13:15]], [[r:1PE.2.5|1Pe 2:5]]; ἐπί τ. θυσιαστήριον, [[r:JAS.2.21|Jas 2:21]] (see Mayor, in l).

G0318.strongs: constraint (literally or figuratively); by implication, distress
G0318.kjv: distress, must needs, (of) necessity(-sary), needeth, needful
senses: necessity: ἔχειν ἀ-, with inf., to be compelled, [[r:LUK.14.18|Luk 14:18 23:17]] (Rec., R, mg.), [[r:1CO.7.37|1Co 7:37]], Ju 3, [[r:HEB.7.27|Heb 7:27]]; ἐξ ἀ., κατ᾽ ἀ., of necessity, [[r:2CO.9.7|2Co 9:7]], [[r:HEB.7.12|Heb 7:12]], Phm 14; ἀ. μοι ἐπίκειται, n. is laid on me, [[r:1CO.9.16|1Co 9:16]]; with inf. (= ἀναγκαῖον ἐστι), [[r:MAT.18.7|Mat 18:7]], [[r:ROM.13.5|Rom 13:5]], [[r:HEB.9.16|Heb 9:16, 23]]

force, violence, hence pain, distress (Diod., al.; LXX; see M, Th., 41; MM, VGT, see word; cf. θλίψις): [[r:LUK.21.23|Luk 21:23]], [[r:1CO.7.26|1Co 7:26]], [[r:1TH.3.7|1Th 3:7]]; pl. (see B1., § 32, 6; Swete, Mk., 153), ἐν ἀ., [[r:2CO.6.4|2Co 6:4 12:10]].† (AS)

G0386.strongs: a standing up again, i.e. (literally) a resurrection from death (individual, genitive case or by implication, (its author)), or (figuratively) a (moral) recovery (of spiritual truth)
G0386.kjv: raised to life again, resurrection, rise from the dead, that should rise, rising again
senses: a raising up, awakening, rising (in Inscr. of the erection of a monument, see MM, VGT, see word): [[r:LUK.2.34|Luk 2:34.]]

of persons in OT hist. (e.g. [[r:3KI.17.17|3Ki 17:17]] ff.): [[r:HEB.11.35|Heb 11:35]]; (with) of the general resurrection: [[r:MAT.22.23|Mat 22:23, 28 22:30]] [[r:MRK.12.18|Mrk 12:18, 23]] [[r:LUK.20.27|Luk 20:27, 33 20:36]], [[r:JHN.11.24|Jhn 11:24]], [[r:ACT.17.18|Act 17:18 23:8 24:15]], [[r:2TI.2.18|2Ti 2:18]]; ἀ. ἐκ νεκρῶν, [[r:LUK.20.35|Luk 20:35]], [[r:ACT.4.2|Act 4:2]]; τῶν νεκρῶν, [[r:MAT.22.31|Mat 22:31]], [[r:ACT.17.32|Act 17:32 23:6 24:21 26:23]], [[r:1CO.15.12|1Co 15:12-13 15:21 15:42]], [[r:HEB.6.2|Heb 6:2]]; ἀ. ζωῆς, resurrection to life (cf. [[r:2MA.7.14|2Ma 7:14]], ἀ. εἰς ζωήν) and ἀ. τ. κρίσεως, τ. to judgment, [[r:JHN.5.29|Jhn 5:29]]; ἀ. τ. δικαίων, [[r:LUK.14.14|Luk 14:14]]; κρείττων ἀ., [[r:HEB.11.35|Heb 11:35]]; on ἡ ἀ. ἡ πρώτη, [[r:REV.20.5|Rev 20:5-8]], see Swete, in l, Weste. on [[r:JHN.5.1|Jhn 5:1-47]], but see also Thayer, see word; by meton. of Christ as Author of ἀ., [[r:JHN.11.25|Jhn 11:25]] (see DB, iv, 231; Cremer, 307).† (AS)
ἀνα-βοάω, -ῶ to cry out: [[r:MAT.27.46|Mat 27:46]] (WH, ἐβόησεν; see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0363.kjv: call to mind, (bring to, call to, put in), remember(-brance)
senses: ἀνα-μιμνήσκω to remind, call to one's remembrance: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:1CO.4.17|1Co 4:17]]; with inf., [[r:2TI.1.6|2Ti 1:6.]] Pass., to remember, call to mind: [[r:MRK.11.21|Mrk 11:21 14:72]], [[r:2CO.7.15|2Co 7:15]], [[r:HEB.10.32|Heb 10:32]].† (AS)

G0332.strongs: to declare or vow under penalty of execration
G0332.kjv: (bind under a) curse, bind with an oath
senses: ἀνα-θεματίζω (ἀνίθεμα), to devote to destruction, declare or invoke ana­thema: absol., [[r:MRK.14.71|Mrk 14:71]]; ἐαντόν, to bind oneself under a curse: [[r:ACT.23.12|Act 23:12, 14 23:21]] (cf. καταναθεματίζω, and on the occurrence of the word in π., see Deiss., LAE, 92 f.; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
to shake out, shake back, move to and fro (Thuc., a1.).
In late writers (Diod., al.; see MM, VGT, see word), to stir up; metaphorically, to excite: τ. ὄχλον, [[r:MRK.15.11|Mrk 15:11]]; τ. λαόν, [[r:LUK.23.5|Luk 23:5.]]† (AS)
to take up, take to oneself: [[r:ACT.7.43|Act 7:43 20:13-14 23:31]], [[r:EPH.6.13|Eph 6:13, 16]], [[r:2TI.4.11|2Ti 4:11]] (for late exx., v MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0392.root: from [[w:G0303]] and the middle voice of [[w:G5021]]
senses: ἀνα-τάσσομαι to arrange in order, bring together from memory (Blass., Phil. Gosp., 14 ff.; MM, VGT, see word): [[r:LUK.1.1|Luk 1:1.]]† (AS)

ἀνα-ζητέω, -ῶ to look for or seek carefully ("specially of searching for human beings, with an implication of difficulty": MM, VGT, see word): [[r:LUK.2.44|Luk 2:44-45]] [[r:ACT.11.25|Act 11:25]].† (AS)

G0380.root: from [[w:G0303]] (in the sense of reversal) and [[w:G4428]]

G0339.strongs: properly, to set up, i.e. (reflexively) to sit up
senses: Intrans., to sit up: [[r:LUK.7.15|Luk 7:15]] (WH, mg., ἐκάθισεν), [[r:ACT.9.40|Act 9:40]] (frequently in medical writings: MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
ἀνά-λημψις, -εως, ἡ (κοινή form of ἀνάληψις; see Th., Gr., 108 f.), a taking up: [[r:LUK.9.51|Luk 9:51]] (MM, VGT, see word).† ἀνά-ληψις, -εως, ἡ, Rec. for ἀνάλημψις, which see (AS)

G0355.root: from [[w:G0303]] and a form of the alternate of [[w:G0138]]
G0355.strongs: properly, to use up, i.e. destroy
senses: ἀν-αλίσκω (on the etymology, see MM, VGT, see word),

G0322.strongs: to exhibit, i.e. (by implication) to indicate, appoint
senses: to lift up and show, show forth, declare (cf. [[r:2MA.2.8|2Ma 2:8]], see MM, VGT, see word): [[r:ACT.1.24|Act 1:24.]]

G0335.root: from a compound of [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle (compare [[w:G0427]])) and [[w:G0127]]
senses: ἀναιδία (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ (αἰδώς), shamelessness, importunity: [[r:LUK.11.8|Luk 11:8]] (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0360.strongs: to break up, i.e. depart (literally or figuratively)
senses: to unloose for departure, depart (MM, VGT, see word): from life, [[r:PHP.1.23|Php 1:23]]

G0352.root: from [[w:G0303]] (in the sense of reversal) and [[w:G2955]]
G0352.strongs: to unbend, i.e. rise; figuratively, be elated
senses: mentally, to be elated: [[r:LUK.21.28|Luk 21:28]] (cf. MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀνα-σπάω, -ῶ to draw up: [[r:LUK.14.5|Luk 14:5]], [[r:ACT.11.10|Act 11:10]] (in π. of pulling up barley; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0376.root: from [[w:G0303]] (in the sense of intensity) and πῆρος (maimed)

senses: ἀνα-ζάω, -ῶ to live again, regain life (cf. cl. ἀναβιόω; Cremer, 722; and for other exx., v MM, VGT, see word): metaphorically of moral revival, [[r:LUK.15.24|Luk 15:24]] (WH, mg., ἔζησεν); of sin, [[r:ROM.7.9|Rom 7:9.]]† (AS)

G0398.strongs: to show, i.e. (reflexively) appear, or (passively) to have pointed out
senses: ἀνα-φαίνομαι to bring to light, make to appear: ἀναφάναντες τ. Κύπρον, i.e. having sighted C.: [[r:ACT.21.3|Act 21:3]] WH; pass., to appear, be made manifest: [[r:LUK.19.11|Luk 19:11]] (AS)

G0334.root: from [[w:G0394]] (like [[w:G0331]], but in a good sense)
senses: (cf. ἀνάθημα, and see MM, VGT, see word), a gift set up in a temple, a votive offering: [[r:LUK.21.5|Luk 21:5]] (LT, -θεμα).† (AS)

(ἀναμιμνήσκω), remembrance: εἰς τ. ἐμὴν ἀ., [[r:LUK.22.19|Luk 22:19]] (WH om.), [[r:1CO.11.24|1Co 11:24-25]]; ἀ. ἁμαρτιῶν, [[r:HEB.10.3|Heb 10:3]] (see Abbott, Essays, 122 ff.; DCG, ii, 74a).† SYN.: ὑπόμνησις (see Tr., Syn., § cvii). (AS)
to a higher authority (Deiss., BS, 229; MM, VGT, see word; cf. also Field, Notes, 140): [[r:LUK.23.7|Luk 23:7, 15]], [[r:ACT.25.21|Act 25:21]].

G0350.strongs: properly, to scrutinize, i.e. (by implication) investigate, interrogate, determine
G0350.kjv: ask, question, discern, examine, judge, search
senses: ἀνα-κρίνω to examine, investigate, question (Lft., Notes, 181 f.): [[r:ACT.17.11|Act 17:11]], [[r:1CO.2.14|1Co 2:14-15 4:3-4 9:3 10:25 10:27 14:24]]; in forensic sense (MM, VGT, see word; esp. of examination by torture; see Field, Notes, 120 f.), [[r:LUK.23.14|Luk 23:14]], [[r:ACT.4.9|Act 4:9 12:19 24:8 28:18]].† SYN.: see: ἐξετάζω (AS)
ἀνα-τρέπω to overturn, destroy: [[r:JHN.2.15|Jhn 2:15]] WH, txt.; metaphorically, to subvert (MM, VGT, see word): [[r:2TI.2.18|2Ti 2:18]], [[r:TIT.1.11|Tit 1:11]].† (AS)

G0312.kjv: declare, rehearse, report, show, speak, tell
senses: to bring back word, report (Æsch., Thuc., al.): [[r:JHN.5.15|Jhn 5:15]] (WH, εἶπεν), [[r:ACT.14.27|Act 14:27 15:4]], [[r:2CO.7.7|2Co 7:7]]

G0361.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G0264]]
senses: In moral sense, faultless (Plat.), without sin: [[r:JHN.8.7|Jhn 8:7]] (see Cremer, 102, 634; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0367.strongs: Ananias, the name of three Israelites

G0390.strongs: to overturn; also to return; by implication, to busy oneself, i.e. remain, live
G0390.kjv: abide, behave self, have conversation, live, overthrow, pass, return, be used
senses: to turn hither and thither; pass., to turn oneself about, sojourn, dwell: [[r:MAT.17.22|Mat 17:22]] Rec.; metaphorically (like Heb. הָלַךְ, in κοινή writers and in π.; see Deiss., LAE, 315; BS, 88, 194; MM, VGT, see word), to conduct oneself, behave, live: [[r:2CO.1.12|2Co 1:12]], [[r:EPH.2.3|Eph 2:3]], [[r:1TI.3.15|1Ti 3:15]], [[r:HEB.10.33|Heb 10:33 13:18]], [[r:1PE.1.17|1Pe 1:17]], [[r:2PE.2.18|2Pe 2:18]]. † SYN.: περιπατέω (Hellenistic), πολιτεύω (AS)
ἀνα-τρέφω to nurse up, nourish, educate, bring up: [[r:LUK.4.16|Luk 4:16]], WΗ, mg., [[r:ACT.7.20|Act 7:20-21 22:3]].† (AS)
a destroying, slaying, murder (Field, Notes, 116; MM, VGT, see word): [[r:ACT.8.1|Act 8:1.]]† (AS)
Of persons connected by bonds of nature or friendship, near, intimate (Field, Notes, 118; ΜΜ, VGT, see word): ἀ. φίλοι, [[r:ACT.10.24|Act 10:24.]]† (AS)

reading (Plat., al.): of the public reading of Scripture (Milligan, NTD, 173, 210 f.): [[r:ACT.13.15|Act 13:15]], [[r:2CO.3.14|2Co 3:14]], [[r:1TI.4.13|1Ti 4:13]] (Cremer, 158; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0384.root: from [[w:G0303]] (in the sense of reversal) and a derivative of [[w:G4632]]
G0384.strongs: properly, to pack up (baggage), i.e. (by implication, and figuratively) to upset
senses: ἀνα-σκευάζω (σκεῦος, a vessel), prop, to pack up baggage, hence, to dismantle, ravage, destroy; metaphorically, to unsettle, subvert (MM, VGT, see word): ψυχάς, [[r:ACT.15.24|Act 15:24.]]† (AS)

G0387.root: from a derivative of [[w:G0450]] (in the sense of removal)
G0387.strongs: properly, to drive out of home, i.e. (by implication) to disturb (literally or figuratively)
G0387.kjv: trouble, turn upside down, make an uproar
senses: ἀνα-στατόω, ῶ (ἀνάστατος, driven from home; ἀνίστημι), to stir up, excite, unsettle: with accusative;

G0333.strongs: to look again (i.e. attentively) at (literally or figuratively)

G0368.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of [[w:G0473]] and [[w:G4483]]
senses: ἀν-αντί-ρητος (Τ, -ρρητος, -ον (ῥητός, spoken), not to be contradicted, undeniable: [[r:ACT.19.36|Act 19:36]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
a going up, an ascent (Pss, ll. with ?).
a step (LXX); p1., a flight of stairs: [[r:ACT.21.35|Act 21:35, 40]]. (On the formation -θμός, see MM, VGT, see word)† (AS)

G0331.strongs: a (religious) ban or (concretely) excommunicated (thing or person)
senses: prop. = τὸ ἀνατιθέμένον, that which is laid by to be kept, a votive offering (as ἀνάθημα in [[r:2MA.2.13|2Ma 2:13]], [[r:LUK.21.5|Luk 21:5]]—where LT read -θεμα, see M, Pr., 46).
devoted, a thing devoted to God (see Driver, De., 98 f., and cf. [[r:LEV.27.28|Lev 27:28-29]]), hence;

of the object on which the curse is laid, accursed ([[r:DEU.7.26|Deu 7:26]]): [[r:ROM.9.3|Rom 9:3]], [[r:1CO.12.3|1Co 12:3 16:22]], [[r:GAL.1.8|Gal 1:8-9]] (see ICC on Ro.; Lft., Ga., ll. with; Cremer, 547; Tr., Syn., § v; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
to give forth, send up, as of plants (Hdt., al.).
to give up, yield, hand over (MM, VGT, see word): [[r:ACT.23.33|Act 23:33.]]† (AS)
ἀνα-βάλλω to defer, put off (MM, VGT, see word): mid., [[r:ACT.24.22|Act 24:22.]]† (AS)

G0394.root: from [[w:G0303]] and the middle voice of [[w:G5087]]
G0394.strongs: to set forth (for oneself), i.e propound
senses: ἀνα-τίθημι to lay upon, set up, etc. Mid. -εμαι, in late writers (Plut., al.; see also MM, VGT, see word), to set forth, declare: [[r:ACT.25.14|Act 25:14]], [[r:GAL.2.2|Gal 2:2]].† (AS)
(ά αβάλλω), delay: [[r:ACT.25.17|Act 25:17]] (for exx. of other meanings, see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀνά-κρισις, -εως, ἡ an examination: spec. of legal preliminary investigation, [[r:ACT.25.26|Act 25:26]] (see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
to assume, undertake (in π. frequently as legal term: MM, VGT, see word): ἐπαγγελίας, [[r:HEB.11.17|Heb 11:17.]]

G0379.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G0626]]
senses: (ἀπολογεόμαι), without excuse, inexcusable (in Polyb., al., as a forensic term; see Lft., Notes, 252): [[r:ROM.1.20|Rom 1:20 2:1]].† (AS)

(ἀνακαινόω), renewal: [[r:ROM.12.2|Rom 12:2]], [[r:TIT.3.5|Tit 3:5]] (Cremer, 324; MM, VGT, see word).† SYN.: παλινγενεσία, in NT, new birth, of which ἀ. is the conse­quent renewal or renovation, in which man as well as God takes part (see Tr., Syn., § xviii) (AS)

G0346.kjv: briefly comprehend, gather together in one
senses: ἀνα-κεφαλαιόω, ῶ (see: κεφαλαιόω) to sum up, gather up, present as a whole: mid., [[r:ROM.13.9|Rom 13:9]], [[r:EPH.1.10|Eph 1:10]] (on WH. see Lft., Notes, 321 L; AR, in l; Cremer, 354, 748).† (AS)
ἀν-άξιος, -ον (ἀ- neg., ἄξιος), unworthy: with genitive, [[r:1CO.6.2|1Co 6:2]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0343.root: from [[w:G0303]] (in the sense of reversal) and [[w:G2572]]
senses: ἀνα-καλύπτω to unveil: metaphorically of removing hindrance to perception of spiritual things, [[r:2CO.3.14|2Co 3:14 3:18]].† (AS)
ἀνα-καινόω, -ῶ = ἀνακαινίζω (cf. MM, VGT, see word), to make new: [[r:2CO.4.16|2Co 4:16]], [[r:COL.3.10|Col 3:10]] (see Cremer, 323).† (AS)
a turning down or back, a wheeling about (Soph., Thuc., al.).

In late writers (Polyb., al.; see: ἀναστρέφω, and cf. Hort on [[r:JAS.3.13|Jas 3:13]]; MM, VGT, see word), manner of life, behaviour, conduct: [[r:GAL.1.13|Gal 1:13]], [[r:EPH.4.22|Eph 4:22]], [[r:1TI.4.12|1Ti 4:12]], [[r:HEB.13.7|Heb 13:7]], [[r:JAS.3.13|Jas 3:13]], [[r:1PE.1.15|1Pe 1:15 1:18 2:12 3:1-2 3:16]], [[r:2PE.2.7|2Pe 2:7 3:11]].† (AS)
ἀνα-νεόω, -ῶ (νέος), to renew: pass., [[r:EPH.4.23|Eph 4:23]] (see Cremer, 428; MM, VGT, see word)† (AS)
ἀνα-θάλλω (θάλλω, to flourish), to revive: [[r:PHP.4.10|Php 4:10]] (of MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀνα-μένω to await "one whose coming is expected, perhaps with the added idea of patience and confidence" with accusative, [[r:1TH.1.10|1Th 1:10]] (see M, Th., in l; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0329.root: from [[w:G0303]] and a compound of the base of [[w:G2226]] and [[w:G4442]]
senses: ἀνα-ζωπυργέω, -ῶ (ζωός, πῦρ), to kindle afresh: metaphorically, [[r:2TI.1.6|2Ti 1:6]] (for vernac. exx., see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0366.strongs: to become sober again, i.e. (figuratively) regain (one's) senses

senses: ἀνά-λυσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀναλύω), a loosing, e.g. of a vessel from its moorings, hence, departure: from life, [[r:2TI.4.6|2Ti 4:6.]]† (AS)
to raise on a cross, crucify (Polyb., al.).

G0382.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G0705]]

senses: ἀνα-γεννάω, -ῶ to beget again: metaphorically, of spiritual birth, [[r:1PE.1.3|1Pe 1:3 1:23]] (cf. Cremer, 147; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀνα-ζώννυμι to gird up: figuratively, τ. ὀσφύας τ. διανοίας, [[r:1PE.1.13|1Pe 1:13.]]† (AS)
ἀναγκαστῶς adv., necessarily or by constraint: opposite to ἑκουσίως, [[r:1PE.5.2|1Pe 5:2]] (rare).† (AS)
